findings.source_and_protocol: PASS. The frozen source hash matches the protocol. The protocol binds four prescribed starts, prior state/gradient and parameter-order provenance, the 25-entry sampling manifest and reference etas. All 60 immutable_file hashes plus the executed-source hash match (61 total checks, zero mismatches). The adapter is a ChemistryBatchObjective subclass; its gradient and trial-scalar methods both call the same qualified streamed full251 F64-shadow evaluator. UNIT_MAXMIN is supplied by the custom aggregation hook; method=pcd is only the existing direct-Armijo API guard. Only the relchem factory changes. The runner loops while cursor<10, so entries 0–9 are the only training/update entries; manifest entry 10 is not consumed.

This review does not claim crash safety for interruption during a checkpoint-file write.
